details: Crypto brokerage Blockchain.com has confidentially submitted a draft registration statement for an Initial Public Offering (IPO) in the United States. This move signals a potential rebound in digital asset markets and renewed investor interest in the sector, despite a choppy period of market volatility and industry setbacks. The filing allows the company to keep financial details private during the review process.
title: Blockchain.com Confidentially Files for US IPO

details: President Donald Trump signed an executive order on May 19, 2026, directing federal regulators, including the Federal Reserve, to review and potentially streamline regulations that impede fintech and crypto companies from accessing traditional financial services and payment systems. The order sets deadlines for identifying barriers and proposing measures to simplify regulations, aiming to bolster US competitiveness in digital finance.
title: Trump Executive Order Aims to Integrate Crypto into US Financial System

details: Offshore crypto platforms like Trade.xyz and Bybit have launched "pre-IPO" perpetual futures contracts linked to SpaceX, allowing traders to speculate on the company's valuation before its anticipated public offering in June. This trend highlights the growing integration of traditional market events into the crypto ecosystem. Additionally, recent SEC filings revealed that SpaceX holds a substantial 18,712 Bitcoin on its balance sheet, surpassing Tesla's reported holdings.
title: Crypto Platforms Launch SpaceX Derivatives Ahead of IPO

details: Bitcoin ETFs experienced significant outflows, totaling over $1 billion since last week's inflation report, marking the largest daily exit since January. This trend is attributed to renewed inflation concerns and elevated geopolitical tensions, particularly regarding the US-Iran conflict, which are weighing on broader risk sentiment. Billionaire investor Mark Cuban stated he sold most of his Bitcoin holdings, criticizing BTC for failing to act as an effective hedge during the US-Iran conflict, noting that gold performed as expected while Bitcoin's price dropped.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See Outflows Amid Inflation Fears and Geopolitical Tensions; Mark Cuban Comments
